title: The Grunion Run, viii
logline: Eighth year. Wood's father is in the crowd. The strip has never drawn him before. It draws his back.

panels.composition: The beach, lanterns, the run. The line for Gully's coffee. WOOD with BARNABY at the edge. In the coffee line, from behind, a man in a mill jacket. The strip draws him like anyone else.

characters.pose: in the line, from behind, a mill jacket

props: a mill jacket in the line

image.prompt: a night beach festival with lanterns and a coffee line, a young man with a small dog at the edge, and in the line seen only from behind an older man in a faded mill jacket, muddy watercolor and ink
image.notes: The father: back only, mill jacket. Never a face, all run.

panels.composition: Gully, handing the mill jacket a cup. Gully's face, careful.

image.prompt: a young man in an apron handing a paper cup to an older man seen from behind, the young man's expression careful, lantern light

panels.composition: Wood, watching from the edge. The dog watching Wood.

image.prompt: a young man at the edge of a lantern-lit beach watching a coffee line with an unreadable face, a small dog looking up at him, no words

panels.composition: Silent. The fish. The lanterns. The mill jacket walking away up the beach with the cup, slowly, small. Wood not drawing.

characters.pose: walking away up the beach, small

image.prompt: silent wide night beach panel with silver fish at the surf, lanterns, and a lone older man in a mill jacket walking slowly away up the sand holding a cup, a young man watching with a closed pad, no words

art.palette: limited, muddy; Sundays in watercolor, improving

notes: The father, from behind, five days before 'One.' He walks slowly. That's the whole diagnosis the strip gives.
